---- Animalistic Spirit Armor ----
=General Script Information=
This is armor with the spirit of an animal trapped within it.
The spirit is wild and must be tamed by unleashing attacks against like-level foes, or successfully evading them during combat.
If not fully tame, the spirit within can backlash upon the owner.
Allegiance can be changed, but the new owner must work off the trust gained by the previous owner.
When the wearer is hit, the armor has a chance to unleash Animalistic Instinct, which can knockdown the attacker and disorient them momentarily.
If used with an Animalistic Spirit weapon or shield, there is a chance the armor will call for aid and also add the weapon/shield's Animalistic Fury flares to the response.
=Alteration Guidelines=
* Alterations to the 15/15/15, long and show of this armor are fine.
* Any merchant can change the associated Armor Accents to match the alteration.
* Some merchants can change the spirit color, spirit call, spirit group, or how the spirit looks.
NOTE: You cannot change the general type of animal, such as changing a large feline to be a canine, except using certificates.
As well, each spirit type only has certain pre-approved nouns allowed.
=Features=
* Animalistic Instinct Flares (Tier 1 of 4)
The spirit within lashes out defensively with a maneuver-based sonic attack, causing knockdown and roundtime.
If you wield an Animalistic Spirit weapon or shield, there is a chance the armor will call for aid and will add Animalistic Fury flares.
Flares are currently: ON [RUB to toggle]
* Revenge Flares = Unlocked
On a successful evade, there is a chance to unleash Animalistic Instinct flares.  You must be in a forward or greater stance and be an active combatant in combat for the spirit to react.
NOTE: Power of this ability is tied to the Flare tier.
If you wield an Animalistic Spirit weapon or shield with Revenge unlocked, there is a chance the armor will call for aid to add Animalistic Fury flares.
* Bestial Barrier = Locked
When Animalistic Instinct flares hit, the spirit within shares some of its strength to defend you, causing an increase to your DS for 30 seconds or until the next attack.
NOTE: Power of this ability is tied to the Flare tier.
* Feral Whirlwind = Locked
Once an hour, direct the spirit within to unleash Animalistic Instinct flares against 3 to 5 creatures in the room in a single sonic attack by STOMPing the robes.
NOTE: Power of this ability is tied to the Flare tier.
* Untamed Vitality = Locked
Once an hour, draw on the vitality of the spirit within your armor for an increase in a combination of Health, Mana, and/or Stamina Recovery by CLENCHing the robes.
* Flavor Actions (Tier 1 of 3)
At this tier, this armor captures the following: WEAR, REMOVE, RUB (Flares On/Off), WHISTLE.
Use PROD to make the spirit less visible while using these actions [Spirit is currently: Awake]
* Tameness/Affinity
Tame the spirit to prevent it enacting its rage upon you.
Only one person can have allegiance to this armor's spirit at a time.
The feeling of this spirit toward someone else is tame (Level 12 of 12).
NOTE: To switch this armor's allegiance to you, you must drop its tameness to the previous owner by damaging like-level creatures or evading attacks from like-level foes while in combat.

When worn, it has a chance to summon a Luukosian lanternbearer after you slay a creature.  When the lanternbearer is slain, the ocarina has a 0% chance to grant an attack, defense, or regenerative boon.  Further, it has a 30% chance to generate a phylactery that can be CLENCH'd to either regain 1-3 spirit or extend one of the boons by 30 seconds, with a 1 hour cooldown.
SETTINGS
Attuned : No one
Charges : 0
Dirge of the Lanternbearer : off
Soulbound Crescendo : 0
Illusion Setting : off, Option 1 - Radiating from the spiral-like lines of the nautilus shell ocarina that drapes from his neck, a pale light surrounds Brodega in a pearlescent aura.
VERBS
cover : Toggles the illusion effect on and off.  Currently: off
raise : Toggles Dirge of the Lanternbearer on and off.  Currently: off
turn : Selects the next illusion or you may "turn ocarina to [1-7]" to select a specific one.  Currently: 1

- WEAVE (a strand of veniom thread) with the container to add weight reduction of 5%

Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.

This blood vial is intended to be a ritualistic potion of some sort.  You can try to POUR, TURN, TILT, DRINK, and MEASURE it.

--LOOK AT ME JEWELRY--
~General Script Information~
This is special jewelry that indicates more precise locations of where and how it is being worn in messaging.
It can have a separate description when it is worn, allowing more flexibility in how it looks.
For example, a ring using this script could indicate it was being worn on the left thumb in its worn description.
Each type of jewelry can only be set to specific positions.
Jewelry can have "sides" unlocked to store more designs/specific positions.
This ring is currently unlocked to: Tier 1 of 2 (OTS)
At this tier, this ring has access to the verbs: WEAR, REMOVE, WAVE (targeted/untargeted).
This ring currently has access to 1 side.
~Alteration Guidelines~
* Alterations to the 15/15/15, long and show of this item can be freely altered.
* This item can have separate descriptions when being worn, as well as when being held.
* Any willing merchant should be able to change the specific position this item can be worn, but not the main area it is worn on.
For example, a ring could be changed to be worn on the left index finger, but NOT be changed to be worn on the wrist.
~Current Settings~
* This item is meant to be worn on a finger, with the specific wear location being on the left ring finger.

Possible specific wear positions for this type of item are: left ring finger, left middle finger, left index finger, left pinky, left thumb, right ring finger, right middle finger, right index finger, right pinky, right thumb.
* Unworn 15/15/15: a teardrop,diamond promise,ring
* Worn 15/15/15: a teardrop,diamond promise,ring
* Worn Long Description: a teardrop diamond promise ring worn around the left ring finger [Default]

Welcome to the one, the only, and the never-before-seen "Paint-in-ator 3000"!

This incredible, amazing, and often underestimated item will thrill you with its ability to store paint.  That's right, Brodega!  It stores paint!  If you aren't sure what to do with paint, then you clearly do not understand the physical strain of a crafter!
Instructions:
1. Hold your paint in hand
2. POUR your paint IN the Paint-in-ator 3000
3. Marvel at the relief to your shoulders as you shed weight
4. GAZE at your Paint-in-ator 3000 to see all the stored paints
Retrieval Instructions:
1. PUSH a crystal amulet (or any of its cousins) into the Paint-in-ator.  (she's a hungry beast!)
2. TAP the Paint-in-ator to determine how many doses you want to retrieve (options: 1 - 5)
3. SPIN the Paint-in-ator to cycle through all the stored paint (50 is max)
4. NUDGE the Paint-in-ator to cycle between paintstick and vial options
5. TURN the Paint-in-ator to collect your paint or paintstick
Please note, any paints poured into the "Paint-in-ator 3000" are consumed by it and can only be retrieved using the methods listed above.
That's right, Brodega, it is that simple!

The Paint-in-ator has the following commands: gaze (displays all stored paint), nudge (cycles between paint and paintstick options), poke (turns on/off third person messaging for spin & tap), pour (adds paint to the device), prod (turns on/off long analyze), pull (removes crystal amulet from the device), push (adds crystal amulet to device), spin (cycles through available paint), tap (cycles through doses to create), turn (provides paint), and whisper (jumps to paint #)

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.

It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of obsidian, an unusual material.  This material cannot be dyed.
Analysis of a glossy obsidian knife indicates the creator has provided the following information:
-- Scrimshaw Knife--
This obsidian knife lets you take bones, antlers, horns, fangs, and teeth and turn them into Weaveable Items.  You can carve designs into them as well.

If unlocked, it can also let you harvest bones, claws/talons, antlers/horns, and hooves from certain creatures.  The resulting items can either be Weaveable or skins that can be used in sheath-making.
==Alteration Guidelines==
* Alterations to the 15/15/15, long and/or show of this obsidian knife are fine.  It needs to follow dagger-base alteration guidelines.

* Custom Weaveable Item slots are meant for the adjective of the created item.   They cannot be longer than 15 characters and should describe how the item is designed, such as a shape, a pattern, a carving style, or the like.  It should feasibly be something that a knife should be able to do to bone (so no colors).

* Custom Weaveable Bead slots are meant to affect the article (first 15) of the created beads.  They cannot be longer than 15 characters and must include a or an.  This should be something feasible you could affect on the beads with a knife, such as a shape, a pattern, a texture, etc., but no colors.

* Custom Hairstick slots require the full long description for the hairsticks.  The 15/15/15 of the created hairsticks is always going to be 'a pair of <material> hairsticks' and the custom should not contradict this.  You are able to include placeholders for: hairstick material and the full name of the bone used to make the hairsticks.

* Custom Lock Mastery clasp slots expect to be provided the noun of the created clasp.  They cannot be longer than 15 characters and should feasibly be something you can clasp a container with.  Only the noun should be provided - no material or color.
==Features==

This obsidian knife has access to the following verbs: WAVE (target a creature or object to use its likeness in designs), CARVE (carve/transform the item in your other hand), TURN (change the design of the item created through CARVE), SPIN (change what type of item CARVE turns things into), POKE (turn a claw/talon/hoof skin into a Weaveable object), FLIP (change article of Weaveable Item or Lock Mastery clasp), POINT (target a dead creature for potential deboning), TWIST (change targeted bone), CUT (remove bone from targeted creature), CLENCH (switch between getting a Weavable bone or a skin-type bone).
You can INSPECT the knife to get some information on how the next item created by CARVE will potentially appear.
Additionally, you can GAZE at the knife to view any custom settings you have applied.
Custom Weaveable Item Adjectives: 2 of 10 Unlocked
Custom Weaveable Bead Articles - 1 of 10 Unlocked
Custom Hairsticks Designs - 2 of 10 Unlocked
Custom Lock Mastery Clasp Nouns - 1 of 10 Unlocked
You can tell that the knife is as light as it can get.

A lace-collared uhl-claw choker dotted in red agate droplets is an Uhl-Claw device designed by the kindred of the T'Kirem Bear Clan. To read more about the lore, visit:  https://gswiki.play.net/Uhl-claw.

To use the choker, you must WEAR it and POINT it at the person you do not wish to make advances on you. Alterations:  An Uhl-Claw must always be made of silver and have a reflective surface for the magic of the item to work.  There should be some representation of the five claws of Uhlgeer, the she-bear, and corresponding crimson drops that represent the blood her claws can bring to the surface.  Droplets can be made of paint, enamel, lacquer, jewels, etc.  Above all, it must have a reflective surface of some kind.  If creating a ring, you may use uhl-ring.  All other jewelry should have an adjective of "uhl-claw," and this item should never be turned into a solitude ring.
The uhl-claw choker will cost 5,000,000 coins.

This is a tier 2 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          200
Deity:                            Eonak
Deity Primary Color:              Pale golden
Deity Secondary Color:            Brown
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready
Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH]:       Ready

If the standard's deity conversion ability is not on cooldown, you may visit a shrine honoring a specific deity to convert the standard to that deity.  To do so, simply PRAY standard TO <deity>.  This ability is subject to a 30 day cooldown, and the cooldown is not currently active.

Wehnimer's Landing.name: a dainty silver chrismarium webbed in rainbow glaes filaments

raw: The ordinary cobalt liquid within the chrismarium is pure and undiluted.
The chrismarium can not be worn.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of silver, an extremely common metal.  This material cannot be dyed.
Analysis of a dainty silver chrismarium webbed in rainbow glaes filaments indicates the creator has provided the following information:

This is a chrismarium, a holy relic that stores the oil and balsam from inside a chrism gem, allowing you to stockpile multiple charges inside for later application to a corpse.  While anyone may add chrism oil to it, it may only be used by clerics to apply the chrism effect.
It may be altered but must remain made of metal, and the noun must remain chrismarium.
This chrismarium is at tier 2 out of 5.  A skilled merchant might be able to unlock it further.
It will hold a maximum of 40 charges.
It is currently using the "Standard" messaging style.

You can PUSH the chrismarium with a chrism in your other hand to store it within.  This destroys the chrism and adds one charge to the chrismarium.  The charges within the chrismarium are as effective as the average of all chrism gems absorbed in this fashion.
You can PROD the chrismarium to stop being warned about when chrism's quality would reduce the average of the chrismarium's contents.
These warnings only apply to the 'fullness' of chrisms and none of their other qualities.

You can POUR the chrismarium on a player to grant them its effects, provided you are skilled in using chrisms.  You can also POUR it on the ground, which wastes a charge but may be useful if you want to replace the contents with higher-quality chrisms.
Unlocked verbs: PUSH, POUR, LOOK, MEASURE, RUB, PROD, PONDER
The dainty silver chrismarium will cost 10,000,000 coins.
It is a holy item.
It appears to weigh about 2 pounds.

It is predominantly crafted of silver.

Wehnimer's Landing.name: a smooth bone ring pierced by tiny crystal shards

raw: Across the surface of the ring, spots of ochre and brown stains radiate from tiny crystalline structures embedded in the bone.  Ichor green motes and shadows lurk within the crystals, living inclusions that alternately lighten and darken the calcification along the ring's edges.  A faint pulse, deep and bone-jarring, accompanies the flickering, beating like a necrotic heart.
The ring can be worn around the finger.  The ring appears to serve some purpose.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of bone, an extremely common material.
Analysis of a smooth bone ring pierced by tiny crystal shards indicates the creator has provided the following information:
The smooth bone ring is a prize from the Arena of the Abyss (Ebon Gate event).  When worn, it has a chance to summon an undead creature from a recently slain creature.
Attuned: No one
Charges: 0 (ON, PROD to toggle)
Lich's Curse: 0% (ON, TAP to toggle)
Voln's Blessing: 0%
Appearance: ON (COVER to toggle)

Lich's Curse is a % chance for the undead the ring spawns to be a boss creature.  Voln's Blessing is a % chance for the ring owner to receive +15 AS/DS and +10 CS/TD for 30 seconds when they kill the undead the ring spawned.
The ring cannot be altered in any way!
The smooth bone ring will cost 325,000 coins.

It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of invar, an unusual metal.
Analysis of a reinforced invar razor indicates the creator has provided the following information:

This is a scarring razor.  It can be used to scar yourself or another who is joined to you.  Scarring razors require some first aid training to use, the better you are, the more efficient you'll be.  The razor must be cleansed and sharpened to get the most of out the item, but over time, the razor will break apart, unless you obtain a special one that will never dull.

Scars will go in the distinguishing mark area of your features, and are permanent.  You will be prompted as to what it will replace.  If something is temporarily altering your features, you will need to remove or stop whatever it is before being scarred.  There is a short cooldown period in between uses to prevent overzealous scarring.
Scar Selection:

To choose how you scar, you must PUSH to select what you'd like to change and PULL to cycle through the choices available.  Custom scars are possible to get from a merchant who can work on the razors.  To select a custom scar, you'd need to TURN the razor.
Scarring Yourself:
In order to scar yourself, you just need to POINT it at yourself.
Scarring Others:
To scar others, they must be following you.  Once grouped, you simply POINT the razor at them and they will need to APPROVE it.  Once approved, they will be scarred.
Razor Maintenance:
Razors need to be cleansed after they are used, and sharpened when they start to dull.  There are several different ways to clean the razor.  Some come with other effects.
The invar razor will cost 4,000,000 coins.

~*~ Moth Cloaks ~*~

This greatcloak is a butterfly/moth cloak with several randomizing points to create multiple unique looks with a single PUSH.  It is Tier 5 out of 5, it has has the "side-unlock" for a temp feature alter + choosing your color, and it is set to the moth setting.  It is set to NOT rotate with day/night changes.  You can APPROVE to toggle this setting.
The greatcloak features an encumbrance reduction (3x/day, 15 minutes each RUB, resets at midnight server time.  There are 3 charges left today.
Utilities:
* APPROVE:  rotates through "moth only," "butterfly only," or "adjust with day/night"
* ATTEND - shows the temporary feature options
* CLEAN:  will clear the selected, stored look
* FIDGET - shows the colors available to permanently set for the forewings on randomized looks
* POKE: takes your randomized look and saves it in 1 of the 2 available stored slots
* PUSH - replaces your randomized look
* TURN - rotates through all saved looks (current randomized look, any stored randomized looks, the custom look, if applicable)
* RUB - activates the encumbrance reduction.
* WHISPER - allows you to set the temporary feature option and the forewing color
Unlocked Fluff Verbs:  observe, tickle, eat, flip, hug, raise, bow, curtsy, brush, touch, and wave
*  WAVE has some "drama llama" options for you!  Try WAVE CLOAK WITH (anger, drama, joy, mystery, or sorrow)
Alterations:
* Base:  must be simple, as it carries across all looks.  The noun must be in the hooded cloak family.
* Material:  must be a type of cloth.  This carries across all looks.
* Colors cannot be referenced in the base or material fields, as colors change based on the settings.
* Custom settings:  The alter points must be provided in this specific order:

** "butterfly adjective^wingtype^forewing color^forewing marking^forewing marking color^forewing marking location^hindwing color^hindwing marking^hinding marking color^hindwing markinglocation^special*moth adjective^wingtype^forewing color^forewing marking^forewing marking color^forewing marking location^hindwing color^hindwing marking^hinding marking color^hindwing marking location^special
** The total character count must be 511 or less
** Moth/Butterfly Adjective alter point must be 15 characters or less.  No a/an needed.
** See the wiki for in-depth information and examples at https://gswiki.play.net/Moth_Cloak
* Custom Look 1 (Butterfly):  You can provide a SHOW for your custom setting.  It cannot contradict the alter points selected for the custom settings.
* Custom Look 2 (Moth):  Same as butterfly, but for the moth version.

* Doing a custom setting is 1 alteration service, as is each custom look (so a custom setting, butterfly look, and moth look are 3 separate alterations.  This is because each one is fairly intricate).
* The base/material can be done by a merchant separately or at the same time as one of the custom alterations.
*  It is up to the individual merchant if they wish to work on these items.

~Restrictions~
* Item MUST indicate it is decorated with some sort of bone in the 15/15/15, long or show.
* Bone adornment CAN be:
- Bones/bone fragments
- Claws/talons
- Teeth/fangs
- Beaks
- Skulls (small)
- Horn/antler pieces
* Bone adornment can NOT be:
- Specific to a race (NO elven finger bones, for example)
- An entire skeleton
- Large bones/skulls
* Currently works with ONLY:
- Leg-worn [skirts, pants, etc.]
- Torso-worn (robes, dresses, shirts, etc.)
- Front-worn (bodices, vests, tabards, etc.)

Analysis of a reinforced invar razor indicates the creator has provided the following information:

This is a scarring razor.  It can be used to scar yourself or another who is joined to you.  Scarring razors require some first aid training to use, the better you are, the more efficient you'll be.  The razor must be cleansed and sharpened to get the most of out the item, but over time, the razor will break apart, unless you obtain a special one that will never dull.

Scars will go in the distinguishing mark area of your features, and are permanent.  You will be prompted as to what it will replace.  If something is temporarily altering your features, you will need to remove or stop whatever it is before being scarred.  There is a short cooldown period in between uses to prevent overzealous scarring.
Scar Selection:

To choose how you scar, you must PUSH to select what you'd like to change and PULL to cycle through the choices available.  Custom scars are possible to get from a merchant who can work on the razors.  To select a custom scar, you'd need to TURN the razor.
Scarring Yourself:
In order to scar yourself, you just need to POINT it at yourself.
Scarring Others:
To scar others, they must be following you.  Once grouped, you simply POINT the razor at them and they will need to APPROVE it.  Once approved, they will be scarred.
Razor Maintenance:
Razors need to be cleansed after they are used, and sharpened when they start to dull.  There are several different ways to clean the razor.  Some come with other effects.
The invar razor will cost 250,000 coins.

raw: The runestaff is shaped from pale-golden surita, its polished grain flowing in soft, natural undulations. Spiraling lines of dachre runes wind downward, their ink-darkened grooves evoking seafoam and curling tides. Near the crown, the markings converge around a smooth knot of wood that gleams like a moonlit tidepool.    It has a small enchanter's glyph.  A strange necrotic haze radiates from the asaya.  A strong aura of holy light radiates from the asaya.
The asaya is a rune staff that requires skill in twohanded weapons to use effectively.

A moonlit surita asaya inked with dachre spirals is a Gift from Atan Irith and created from a rare piece of surita.  The surita tree is only found on the Erithi Homeland, though it was sold at The Grand Tourney.
This particular piece is constructed of ocean surita, which has a white woodgrain striated by moss agate and indigo hues.

The basket can be worn, attaching it to the belt.

Analysis of a small wicker basket indicates the creator has provided the following information:
Welcome to the Basketifier, straight out of the shop Preserving Breads at Evermore Hollow!
This basket is designed to hold food items for you.  It will keep them fresh and unlimited until you decide to remove them.
It is currently tier 4 of 4, which means it will house 24 food items.
To use the basket, simply follow these steps:
1. PUT - use this to add food items to the basket.
2. RUB - use this to prepare a food item for removal.
3. TURN - Use this to remove a food item from the basket.  (must be charged with a small statue)
To create a picnic, follow these steps:
1. PULL - to pull the blanket out.  This will move all food to the blanket, and the basket will be turned into a trashcan.
2. PUSH - to clean up the picnic.  This will move all food and the blanket back into the basket and return the basket to its natural state.
The picnic will stick around for two hour(s) before folding up.  This can be renewed using HUG.
To create a table, follow these steps:
1. PROD - to set the table out.  This will move all food items onto the table, and the basket will be turned into a trashcan.
2. TINKER - to clean up the table.  This will move all food back into the basket and return the basket to its natural state.
The table will stick around for two hour(s) before folding up.  This can be renewed using HUG.
A small wicker basket has 1 charges stored in it that can be used to remove food.
Alterations:
The basket may be altered freely, but it must remain a basket.  It can have a long or show description.
Basket's Blanket: a fringed red and black cloth
It must maintain a noun of blanket, cloth, tablecloth, or something similar.  It may have a long or a show description and must be made of fabric.
Table Base: a rough oak table
The table must keep the noun table.  It may have a long or a show description and needs to be made of wood.
Customizing food in the basket is a special, delayed service.
The wicker basket will cost 4,000,000 coins.

This is a chrismarium, a holy relic that stores the oil and balsam from inside a chrism gem, allowing you to stockpile multiple charges inside for later application to a corpse.  While anyone may add chrism oil to it, it may only be used by clerics to apply the chrism effect.
It may be altered but must remain made of metal, and the noun must remain chrismarium.
This chrismarium is at tier 2 out of 5.  A skilled merchant might be able to unlock it further.
It will hold a maximum of 40 charges.
It is currently using the "Standard" messaging style.

You can PUSH the chrismarium with a chrism in your other hand to store it within.  This destroys the chrism and adds one charge to the chrismarium.  The charges within the chrismarium are as effective as the average of all chrism gems absorbed in this fashion.
You can PROD the chrismarium to stop being warned about when chrism's quality would reduce the average of the chrismarium's contents.
These warnings only apply to the 'fullness' of chrisms and none of their other qualities.

You can POUR the chrismarium on a player to grant them its effects, provided you are skilled in using chrisms.  You can also POUR it on the ground, which wastes a charge but may be useful if you want to replace the contents with higher-quality chrisms.
Unlocked verbs: PUSH, POUR, LOOK, MEASURE, RUB, PROD, PONDER

Analysis of a large mithglin gizmo indicates the creator has provided the following information:
OVERVIEW

Hello there, intrepid adventurer!  This mithglin gizmo is a Junk Bomb item.  These items allow you to weightlessly store 5 kinds of treasure system junk and use it as ammunition/shrapnel via a giant, perfectly safe explosion!  The item may hold up to 30 of each item and each shot consumes up to 30 charges to deal damage to a target.  For each item consumed, 1 cycle of damage is inflicted.
VERBS
LIGHT - ignite the gizmo and set it to fire.
DISARM - disarms the gizmo and stops it from firing once it has been LIGHTed.
TINKER - repairs the gizmo after it has fired.
TURN - rotates to the next cylinder for firing.
PUT - drop a junk item into the device, storing it for future use.
RUB - Fluff.
MECHANICS

When the you LIGHT the gizmo, it will ignite for 5 seconds. After those 5 seconds, it will fire and shoot 5-30 pieces of shrapnel at your target (or a random creature if you're not targetting anything.)  The damage severity is based on item type and moldy bones will leave behind a Death Cloud (1712) while tattered cloths will leave behind a room Web (118).
Currently, the gizmo contains:
7 / 30 Chipped Bricks
15 / 30 Table Legs
22 / 30 Rusty Doorknobs
12 / 30 Moldy Bones
20 / 30 Tattered Cloths
The gizmo may currently fire 2 times per day.  It is currently fixed.
ALTERING

This item may be freely altered but must remain consistent with the script: it should be an item that has multiple cylinders to load items into that spin around a central axis.  It should be in good operating order but may show signs of wear-and-tear.
The mithglin gizmo will cost 3,000,000 coins.

Analysis of a beige dagswain cape with red-stitched geometric designs indicates the creator has provided the following information:

A beige dagswain cape with red-stitched geometric designs is part of the Shield Cape Collection, which was purchased at Duskruin in the shop "Shield Thyself".  It is a passive defense item that has a chance to block an incoming blow.  The chance increases with each tier that is unlocked.  If the wearer has no weapons in his hands, no shield/runestaff, or is using a bow/crossbow, then he gets the full benefit of the cape.  Otherwise the chance is halved.
Its current status is OTS and that gives it access to the following verbs: pull (removes brooch), push (adds brooch), remove, turn (removes bangle), twist (adds bangle), wear
To upgrade its abilities, you will need to obtain an unlock certificate.

Brooch Data: (Brooch is Absent) A copper and boar tusk cloak pin can be changed by using PULL to remove the brooch and PUSH to add a new one.  Please note, only specialized brooches will work.  Once your brooch is upgraded from the default piece, it unlocks a 50% chance to retain a charge within it for each successful block.  When the brooch reaches 10 charges, it automatically flares and absorbs all of the charges.

Bangle Data: (Bangle is absent) A polished tortoise shell bangle can be changed by using TURN to remove the bangle and TWIST to add a new one.  Please note, only specialized bangles will work.  Once your bangle is upgraded from the default piece, it provides an additional 25% chance to absorb a charge.  It will not provide this additional percentage chance if the brooch is not upgraded.  Additionally, bangles can have special unlocks to change the flare type.
There are currently 0 charges stored in this beige dagswain cape.

You may alter a beige dagswain cape with red-stitched geometric designs freely providing it does not contradict the messaging.  The cape can never be a jacket, a longcoat, a coat, a robe, or any similar nouns based on its design.  Nor will it ever have a hood.  This garment will attach at the left wrist by a bangle, slide over the arm and across the left shoulder.  It will then dip down the back (under wings for the Aelotoi), under the right arm, and can be pulled across the chest so that it is pinned at the left shoulder with a brooch.
You might be able to have a talented merchant lighten the beige dagswain cape for you or deepen its pockets.

Basrenne   - Forest Gnome   - Chain of woven or linked reeds which can be dyed. Gem is in its mostly natural state.
Elothrai   - Erithi         - Always uses an agate or an agita for the gem.
Ferrigem   - Burghal Gnome  - Chain uses bits and pieces of different metals, gem is in slivers or a shard, and a tiny gear or gadget is worked in somewhere.
Geldaralad - Elves          - Requires a twisted vaalin chain.
Khazurka   - Dwarf          - Mithril chain, cut gem, often very detailed.
Seer-stone - Human          - Oval-cut stone turned lengthwise to resemble a third eye.
Trinette   - Halfling       - Tri-stranded chain, trilliant-cut gem, and an elaborate setting.
For more information on the details of Ferroniere's you can go to:
https://gswiki.play.net/Ferroniere

---- Animalistic Spirit Weapons ----
=General Script Information=
This is a weapon with the spirit of an animal trapped within it.

The spirit is wild and must be tamed by unleashing it against like-level foes (successful hits), as well as successful parries (melee/runestaves) or evades (UCS/ranged) from like-level foes during combat.
If not fully tame, the spirit within can backlash upon the owner.
Allegiance can be changed, but the new owner must work off the trust gained by the previous owner.
When striking, there is a chance the spirit will unleash Animalistic Fury flares.
=Alteration Guidelines=
* Alterations to the 15/15/15, long and show of this weapon are fine.
* Some merchants can change the spirit color, spirit call, spirit group, or how the spirit looks.
NOTE: You cannot change the general type of animal, such as changing a large feline to be a canine, except using certificates.
As well, each spirit type only has certain pre-approved nouns allowed.
=Features=
* Animalistic Fury Flares (Tier 4 of 4)
The spirit within lashes out with a stampede. (Damage Type: Grapple)
Flares are currently: ON [RUB to toggle]
* Revenge Flares = Unlocked

On a successful parry (melee/runestaves) or evade (UCS/ranged), there is a chance to unleash Animalistic Fury flares.  You must be in a forward or greater stance and be an active combatant in combat for the spirit to react.
NOTE: Power of this ability is tied to the Flare tier.
* Wild Backlash = Unlocked
When Animalistic Fury flares hit, the spirit within lashes out with its untamed anger, causing a momentary reduction in the target's DS and TD.
NOTE: Power of this ability is tied to the Flare tier.
* Savage Power = Unlocked (Tier 5 of 5)
Once an hour, draw on the power of the spirit within your weapon for an increase in AS, CS and critical padding by CLENCHING the kunai.
* Flavor Actions (Tier 3 of 3)

At this tier, this weapon captures the following: GET, DROP, RUB (Flares On/Off), WHISTLE, TURN (targeted/untargeted), RAISE, POINT (targeted/untargeted), CLEAN, PRAY, BOW (targeted/untargeted), EXHALE, WAVE (targeted/untargeted).
* Tameness/Affinity
Tame the spirit to prevent it enacting its rage upon you.
Only one person can have allegiance to this weapon's spirit at a time.
The feeling of this spirit toward someone else is wild (Level 1 of 12).

NOTE: To switch this weapon's allegiance to you, you must drop the weapon's tameness to the previous owner by damaging like-level creatures with it or successfully parrying (melee/runestaff) or evading (UCS/ranged) attacks from a like-level foe while in active combat.

This is a tier 2 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          200
Deity:                            Phoen
Deity Primary Color:              Bright golden
Deity Secondary Color:            Blue
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready
Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH]:       Ready

If the standard's deity conversion ability is not on cooldown, you may visit a shrine honoring a specific deity to convert the standard to that deity.  To do so, simply PRAY standard TO <deity>.  This ability is subject to a 30 day cooldown, and the cooldown is not currently active.

This is a tier 3 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.

1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.

Wehnimer's Landing.name: a sacrosanct bright white battle standard with a rippling muted black sheen

raw: A faint muted black sheen ripples along the standard's fabric at measured intervals, a counterpoint to the pulsing gleam of the runes scribed along the full length of the pole.
You determine that you could wear a sacrosanct bright white battle standard with a rippling muted black sheen as a battle standard.
Analysis of a sacrosanct bright white battle standard with a rippling muted black sheen indicates the creator has provided the following information:
This is a tier 3 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

Oblong in shape, with a length of about six hands, the wooden box is an interesting device.  Two glass buttons blink in tandem on the back of the box; the dull blue one blinks over a small drawer and the bright silver one flashes over a panel.  Between the two buttons is a turn style knob that sits above a small window with the words, "Forging Blocks," positioned in the center.  At the top of the piece is a small door that dominates seven-eighths of the expanse, with the remaining space being occupied by a large, round lid.  A window on the right side provides a view of the sawdust-lined interior.
It is estimated that a copper-caged cocobolo contraption can store a fairly small amount with enough space for one item.
The contraption can not be worn.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of wood, an extremely common material.
Analysis of a copper-caged cocobolo contraption indicates the creator has provided the following information:
*Congratulations on your purchase of the Woodn't Yew's premier product: The WoodChopper Box.*
The WoodChopper Box is able to take your unwanted wooden shields, bows, crossbows, runestaffs, and
quarterstaffs, and turn them into something else with a flick of a switch and the press of a
button.  All your wildest dreams can come true with this amazing creation.  That's an exaggeration,
but just wait and see what it can do!
Instructions:
Step 1 - PUT your unwanted piece of wood into your WoodChopper Box.
Step 2 - Either CAST Minor Shock (901) or Major Shock (910) at the contraption OR PUSH a silver
wand into your WoodChopper Box*.
*NOTE* - The WoodChopper Box can hold a maximum of 40 charges.  When using a silver wand,
please note that it will fully deplete all charges from the wand.  Item creation
will use 10 charges each time.
Step 3 - NUDGE an appropriate gem into your WoodChopper Box in order charge it for zesting.
(optional)
*NOTE* - What you can make is dependent on the value of the gem you sacrifice.
**DISCLAIMER** - Sacrifice of the gem is PERMANENT and cannot be undone.  Once your
WoodChopper Box eats your gem, it is gone and you cannot get it back.
Step 4 - TINKER with your WoodChopper Box's dials to find which result you want. (optional)
Step 5 - PROD the switch on your WoodChopper Box to further determine what type of the thing you
wish to create.  This option is only available for weavables, cobbling materials,
fletching shafts, and forageables. (optional)
Step 6 - POKE the switch on your WoodChopper Box to select which finish you wish to create for
your new item.  This option is only available for toothpicks, waveables, cobbling mats,
hairpicks, and lockmastery clasps. (optional)
Step 7 - SPIN the dial on your WoodChopper Box to select which shape you wish your item to be
created as.  This option is only available for weavables, cobbling settings, hairpicks,
and lockmastery clasps. (optional)
Step 8 - TWIST the lever on your WoodChopper Box and listen as it chops your wood up and creates
something better.
Step 9 - TURN the knob on your WoodChopper Box to get your new item.
Additional Instructions:
* If you decided you do not want to make an item just yet, you can TURN your WoodChopper Box to
retrieve your wooden sacrifice.
* If you wish to clear your WoodChopper Box's charges, you can PULL it.
* If you wish to clear out the gem in your WoodChopper Box, you can PINCH it.
This WoodChopper Box is currently unlocked to Tier 3, fully unlocked, and has access to the
following verbs:
DROP, SHOW, PULL, PUSH, TURN, TWIST, NUDGE, PINCH, TINKER, POKE*, PONDER, PROD, SPIN
*POKE offers additional functionality at Tier 3.
This WoodChopper Box is currently set up to make:
Tier 1  -  Forging Blocks
Tier 2  -  Toothpicks
Weavable Beads
Foraged Sticks
Foraged Bark
Tier 3  -  Lockmastery Clasps
Cobbling Materials
Fletching Shafts
HairPicks
Cobbling Heels

won't play nicely with them.

Nouns: When customizing nouns, please keep in singular form.

zested items.  Tier 2 items will require a gem with a value of 500 silvers or higher, while Tier 3
items will require a gem valued at 1000 silvers or more.
*Alterations*
The WoodChopper box has a hard-coded show description, which cannot be altered.  However, it can

Teras Isle.name: an asymmetrical dark green jewel striated by gold inclusions

raw: A mirage-like haze of arcane influence clings to the jewel, alight with half-glimpsed glyphs refracting across its facets from within.  The effect is dizzying and makes further visual inspection difficult.
The jewel appears to be a powerful relic that can convey wondrous abilities on its wielder.  It has the following property:
Rarity:      Common
Mnemonic:    cuttingcorners
Description: Bounties with repetitions will be given with 1d3 fewer repetitions required.

You note the telltale filaments of a lesser binding shimmering around the dark green jewel.  You can sense that the jewel is bound to Yakushi, but a sufficiently skilled artificer should be able to dispel the binding.
The jewel can not be worn.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of gemstone, an extremely common material.

trailing a series of verdigris hoops trailing amber beads on their outer edges

Globe Type: Globe, Orb, Sphere, Spheroid, Ball, Skull

An ornate kakore scepter etched with gnashing tormented souls can be altered with a long or a show description.  If it has a long description, then it will always have a show of "Firmly wedged at the top of the length of kakore is an obsidian skull."  However, if it does not have a show description, then it will always have a show of "Sinew and rawhide bind the top of the length of kakore to create a cradle for an obsidian skull that rests within it."  If you are designing your own show, you may ask your alterer to include how the skull is wedged into the scepter, but it must always be at the top.

This is the Globus Elanthias scepter, or more commonly the Soul Eater scepter.  It has ghastly shadows as its flare type.  There is an skull made of obsidian that is wedged into the top of the length of kakore, and it can be customized in the following way:
Globe Type: Globe, Orb, Sphere, Spheroid, Ball, Skull

An ornate kakore scepter etched with gnashing tormented souls can be altered with a long or a show description.  If it has a long description, then it will always have a show of "Firmly wedged at the top of the length of kakore is an obsidian skull."  However, if it does not have a show description, then it will always have a show of "Sinew and rawhide bind the top of the length of kakore to create a cradle for an obsidian skull that rests within it."  If you are designing your own show, you may ask your alterer to include how the skull is wedged into the scepter, but it must always be at the top.

Polychromatic sparkles reflect off the wings of the cloak.  The cloak's interior has several pockets, ties, and straps to hide items away.
It is estimated that a fairywing moth cloak of berry-hued damask can store a gigantic amount with enough space for any number of items.
The cloak can be worn, hanging it from the shoulders.  The cloak appears to serve some purpose.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of cloth, an extremely common material.
Analysis of a fairywing moth cloak of berry-hued damask indicates the creator has provided the following information:
~*~ Moth Cloaks ~*~

This cloak is a butterfly/moth cloak with several randomizing points to create multiple unique looks with a single PUSH.  It is Tier 5 out of 5, and it is set to the moth setting.  It is set to NOT rotate with day/night changes.  You can APPROVE to toggle this setting.
The cloak features an encumbrance reduction (3x/day, 15 minutes each RUB, resets at midnight server time.  There are 3 charges left today.
Utilities:
* APPROVE:  rotates through "moth only," "butterfly only," or "adjust with day/night"
* CLEAN:  will clear the selected, stored look
* POKE: takes your randomized look and saves it in 1 of the 2 available stored slots
* PUSH - replaces your randomized look
* TURN - rotates through all saved looks (current randomized look, any stored randomized looks, the custom look, if applicable)
* RUB - activates the encumbrance reduction.
Unlocked Fluff Verbs:  observe, tickle, eat, flip, hug, raise, bow, curtsy, brush, touch, and wave
*  WAVE has some "drama llama" options for you!  Try WAVE CLOAK WITH (anger, drama, joy, mystery, or sorrow)
Alterations:
* Base:  must be simple, as it carries across all looks.  The noun must be in the hooded cloak family.
* Material:  must be a type of cloth.  This carries across all looks.
* Colors cannot be referenced in the base or material fields, as colors change based on the settings.
* Custom settings:  The alter points must be provided in this specific order:

** "butterfly adjective^wingtype^forewing color^forewing marking^forewing marking color^forewing marking location^hindwing color^hindwing marking^hinding marking color^hindwing markinglocation^special*moth adjective^wingtype^forewing color^forewing marking^forewing marking color^forewing marking location^hindwing color^hindwing marking^hinding marking color^hindwing marking location^special
** The total character count must be 511 or less
** Moth/Butterfly Adjective alter point must be 15 characters or less.  No a/an needed.
** See the wiki for in-depth information and examples at https://gswiki.play.net/Moth_Cloak
* Custom Look 1 (Butterfly):  You can provide a SHOW for your custom setting.  It cannot contradict the alter points selected for the custom settings.
* Custom Look 2 (Moth):  Same as butterfly, but for the moth version.

* Doing a custom setting is 1 alteration service, as is each custom look (so a custom setting, butterfly look, and moth look are 3 separate alterations.  This is because each one is fairly intricate).
* The base/material can be done by a merchant separately or at the same time as one of the custom alterations.
*  It is up to the individual merchant if they wish to work on these items.

Analysis of an invar-bound carved boar tusk indicates the creator has provided the following information:
The Ale Festival Drinking Horn
Designed to store liquid and will hold a maximum of 20 sips, though some special containers are offered that are unlimited.
Verb Traps: CLOSE, DRINK, MEASURE, OPEN, REMOVE, TURN, POUR*, WEAR
* POUR - This verb works one-way, allowing you to fill the tusk.
Unlocks:
Any dwarven merchant may unlock this item and any Ale Festival Merchant may as well.
Alterations:

The noun must remain horn or tusk.  The overall design must remain dwarven in nature.  Bandings, tips, and ornaments made of common dwarven materials like invar, mithril, and glaes, are encouraged in their descriptions.  Dwarves also like gems; feel free to adorn them with all types of gemstones found across Elanthia when altering these items.  Mundane and magical creatures alike throughout Elanthia can be used for the primary material of these drinking vessels as long as they have large enough horns or tusks to drink from.  (e.g. minotaur horn, ox horn, vor'taz horn, tsark tusk, boar tusk).
Customizations:

Lid/Cap option requires a noun (ie: lid, cap, cover).  Tip/end is the referencing point of the lid and can be either material or a gemstone.  Ornament can be a design that is carved into the side of the tusk and will always start with "the" in the areas it is displayed.  Strap/chain is referenced when wearing the tusk and should include a noun.  It will always be preceded by "the."  Clasp/buckle is referenced when wearing and removing the tusk.  It is the method by which the tusk is held in place.  It is always preceeded by "its" or "the."  When altering the solemn toast, capitalize the sentence and do not use punctuation.
Customization Fields:
Lid/Cap: mistwood lid
Tip/End: invar-bound end
Ornament: dwarven emblem
Strap/Chain: strap
Clasp/buckle: clasp
Solemn Toast: To kin and kegs.
Cheerful Toast: (ONLY VISIBLE WITH UNLOCK) - May your barrels never run dry!
Special Dwarven Abilities:
* Ability to drink from the tusk while it is worn.
An invar-bound carved boar tusk is tier 1 of 2 tiers.
The carved boar tusk will cost 150,000 coins.
